verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a platform that ships SDKs, a local MCP server, and an in-product AI assistant. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. Related controls such as DISALLOW_WRITES, SANDBOX mode, and OAuth scopes are access restrictions, not telemetry controls, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
